## Kyoto Spring Trip Overview
A relaxed 4-day Kyoto plan for **2 adults** with a **USD 900 sightseeing budget** is very workable. This itinerary keeps each day to **3 major activities max**, emphasizes **temples, local food, public transit**, and includes **one easy day trip**.

## 4-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Budget
### Day 1: Higashiyama Welcome Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and start with **Kiyomizu-dera** and the surrounding lanes.
- Afternoon: Stroll **Sannenzaka / Ninenzaka**, then visit **Yasaka Shrine** or nearby Gion streets.
- Dinner: Try a casual **kaisendon, yudofu, or ramen** dinner in central Kyoto.
- Estimated cost for 2: **USD 110–150**
  - Transit: USD 10–20
  - Entry fees: USD 20–30
  - Food: USD 80–100

### Day 2: Arashiyama Temple Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Tenryu-ji** and the **Bamboo Grove** before crowds build.
- Afternoon: Visit **Okochi Sanso Garden** or the **Togetsukyo Bridge** area at an easy pace.
- Dinner: Eat in Kyoto city center or Arashiyama, focusing on **tofu, soba, or tempura**.
- Estimated cost for 2: **USD 120–170**
  - Transit: USD 10–20
  - Entry fees: USD 30–50
  - Food: USD 80–100

### Day 3: Kyoto City Temples and Markets
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Visit **Nijo Castle** or **Nishiki Market** first, depending on whether you want history or food.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Visit **Nijo Castle** or **Nishiki Market** first, depending on whether you want history or food, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Choose one major temple area such as **Kinkaku-ji** or **Ryoan-ji**.
- Dinner: Make this your best local-food night with **yakitori, obanzai, or a set meal**.
- Estimated cost for 2: **USD 130–190**
  - Transit: USD 10–20
  - Entry fees: USD 30–60
  - Food: USD 90–110

### Day 4: Easy Day Trip to Nara
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take the train to **Nara** and visit **Todai-ji** and **Nara Park**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/25/DeerNaraJapan.jpg Alt=Morning: Take the train to **Nara** and visit **Todai-ji** and **Nara Park**, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Add **Kasuga Taisha** or a slow walk through the park area.
- Dinner: Return to Kyoto for a relaxed final meal near your hotel.
- Estimated cost for 2: **USD 120–180**
  - Transit: USD 20–40
  - Entry fees: USD 20–40
  - Food: USD 80–100

### Budget Snapshot
- Total estimated sightseeing spend for 2: **USD 480–690**
- Comfortable buffer remaining from your budget: **USD 210–420**
- Best use of extra budget: nicer dinners, a tea experience, or a taxi once if needed.

## Day-by-Day Plan at a Glance
| Day | Focus | Major Stops | Estimated Cost for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Eastern Kyoto temples | Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka, Gion/Yasaka Shrine | USD 110–150 |
| 2 | Arashiyama | Tenryu-ji, Bamboo Grove, Togetsukyo/Okochi Sanso | USD 120–170 |
| 3 | Central Kyoto culture + food | Nishiki Market, Nijo Castle or Kinkaku-ji, local dinner | USD 130–190 |
| 4 | Easy day trip | Nara Park, Todai-ji, Kasuga Taisha | USD 120–180 |

## Simple Packing Checklist
- Passport and travel insurance details
- IC card or mobile transit payment setup
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light jacket or cardigan for cool mornings/evenings
- Compact umbrella or rain shell
- Reusable water bottle
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Phone charger and power bank
- Cash in yen for small shops and temple fees
- Portable tissues and hand sanitizer
- Basic temple-appropriate clothing: shoulders and knees covered for some sites
- Camera or phone with extra storage
